newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: El Salvador, Nicaragua banks form alliance.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador, Nicaragua banks form alliance.

text.p: Aiming to build up a banking network wthroughout Central America, El Salvador's Agricola Comercial bank signed an agreement Friday to form an alliance with the Nicaraguan bank Caley Dagnall, the chairman of the Salvadoran bank said.
Agricola Comercial Chairman Archie Baldocchi said the Salvadoran institution chose Caley Dagnall to link up with because it is "one of the soundest and best organised" banks in Nicaragua.
Baldocchi told a news conference the two will explore investment opportunities in Guatemala and Costa Rica to consolidate a financial network in the region.
Agricola Comerical already has subsidiaries in Panama, Honduras and the United States, Baldocchi said.
Caley Dagnall Chairman Leonardo Somarriba said as a result of the alliance his bank increased its share capital by around $3 million.
